FN-XDBWQ7E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 89
Committee: Constitutions, campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 89 as introduced could increase receipts to Class 4 municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent on the difference in 1) the current filing fees set by the
governing body, up to $50, as provided by the current law; and 2) the qualifying fees for
candidates for council member and municipal board of education member of $250 and $500 for
mayor.
Page 1
